title: Maxx Crosby to Bengals? Pacman Jones weighs in after failed Ravens trade

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Maxx Crosby to Bengals? Pacman Jones weighs in after failed Ravens trade
sources.description: Adam "Pacman" Jones floated the Bengals as a possible destination for Maxx Crosby after a trade between the Raiders and Ravens fell through.
